text: {"label":"Functional Communication Training and Schedule Thinning","definition":"Research on functional communication training to replace problem behavior, including reinforcement schedule thinning with multiple or chained schedules, persistence, resurgence and renewal, and refinements that improve treatment efficacy and effectiveness.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on communication responses as replacements for problem behavior, unlike conversation-skill teaching, behavioral skills training of staff, or verbal stimulus control and intraverbal relations."}
